mon.dinner: Mushroom & kale frittata, hot-honey Brussels sprouts
mon.notes: Moved up to use the mushrooms and kale before they turn. Cast iron on stovetop, covered, 8-10 min. Sprouts in air fryer 380F 12-14 min, tossed with hot honey last 2 min.

tue.notes: Black bean + sweet potato, or chicken, in corn tortillas.

wed.dinner: Creamy white bean & kale skillet, garlic toast
wed.notes: Onion/garlic/spice prep can be done ahead.

thu.dinner: Turmeric-ginger coconut lentil & sweet potato dal, garlicky wilted kale
thu.notes: Anti-inflammatory turmeric, ginger, garlic base, coconut milk instead of tomato. Last higher-fiber night before meals get gentler starting tomorrow.

fri.dinner: Turmeric-ginger silken tofu & white rice bowl, steamed peeled carrots
fri.notes: Low-fiber meals start tonight: white rice (not brown), peeled and well-cooked veg only, no skins, seeds, or whole grains. Soft scrambled eggs on the side for extra protein if wanted.

sat.dinner: Soft scrambled eggs & melted gouda over white rice, mashed peeled sweet potato, silky steamed spinach
sat.notes: Still low-fiber: rice not brown, sweet potato peeled and mashed smooth, spinach well-cooked and kept to a small portion.
